title: Air-Fryer Sweet Potato Fries
subtitle: Lightly spiced sweet potato fries from the air fryer
excerpt: Sweet potato cut into thin fries, tossed with olive oil and smoked paprika, and cooked in the air fryer until the edges crisp up and the centre stays soft. Ready in 20 minutes.

recipe.sourceNotes: Sweet potato fries are harder to get truly crisp than regular potato fries because of their higher sugar and water content. The air fryer helps by circulating hot air around each piece, but the fries should be cut thin (0.5 to 1 cm) and spread in a single layer with space between each piece. They will never be as crisp as standard chips but are much better from an air fryer than an oven.

content.text: Cut the fries thin: thick sweet potato pieces do not crisp up properly. Shake the basket every 6 minutes. The fries are done when the edges are golden and beginning to catch. Do not overcook or they turn mushy. They are at their best eaten within 5 minutes of coming out of the air fryer.
Preheat the air fryer to 200 C for 3 minutes. Pat the sweet potato fries dry with kitchen paper. Toss with the olive oil, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper.
Spread the fries in a single layer in the air fryer basket with space between each piece. Cook in batches if needed.
Cook at 200 C for 16 to 18 minutes, shaking the basket every 6 minutes, until the edges are golden and beginning to crisp.
Season with a pinch more salt on coming out. Serve immediately.
